verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own docs say organizations let users share collections and environments with colleagues. Projects can use Cloud Sync or Git Sync, with an encrypted sync process, an in-app merge view for conflicts, RBAC and unlimited contributors. Together this covers synced shared team workspaces. Missing for 10: detailed docs on Cloud Sync real-time workspace behavior, independent or hands-on evidence that team sync works as claimed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share collections with my team in a synced shared workspace

citations.quote: Insomnia organizations allows users to share collections and environments safely and securely with their colleagues.
You can convert a project to: - Local Vault - Cloud Sync - Git Sync
Collaboratively create APIs with an unlimited number of contributors
At no point in the sync process can the Insomnia servers read or access sensitive application project data.
Insomnia opens a merge view so you can review and resolve conflicts without leaving the app.
